claims.title: Polynomial-bit constructive rounding candidate for matroid bases

scoped_dependencies.relation: Scoped constructive continuation. N689 reports a broader Boolean-polytope existence classification. N692 reports a polynomial-bit construction for matroid bases using related face-descent/spectral machinery; it does not validate N689 or establish an algorithm for every bounded-exchange Boolean polytope.

Algorithmic context only. N24 preserves its own executable cube and partition-base procedures, bounds, acquisition contract, and general-matroid feasibility gate. N692 is a distinct source-reported general-matroid-basis construction and does not independently validate or replace N24.

interface: Arbitrary matroid by independence oracle; rational unit-Euclidean-column-normalized matrix and rational base-polytope point. The response claims a polynomial-bit basis with a nonincreasing rational objective and discrepancy at most 262336.
limits: Exact unbiased probabilities are constructed with at most n+1 bases; exact rational rejection sampling is only claimed polynomial in expectation. Full end-to-end implementation and standalone proof package are unavailable.
status: source_derived_unreviewed; independent correctness, formal verification, and historical priority UNKNOWN.
